sentences.en: I borrowed the notebook PC from the junior staff member.
sentences.zh: 我从那位初级职员那里借了笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: We will post the announcement in all the staff lounges.
sentences.zh: 我们要在所有的员工休息室张贴公告。

sentences.en: He consulted with some of the staff on the matter.
sentences.zh: 他和一些员工就此事进行了咨询。
